finding: TWO, AND BOTH CAME FROM MEASURING RATHER THAN REASONING. (1) THE AUDIT AUT-PD-168 ASKED FOR CHOOSES ITS FIX: intersecting every workflow's text and `git add` targets with the manifest's 484-path inventory, 33 of 34 workflows can write an inventoried file and exactly 2 mention the manifest at all — one of which only checks it. Six commit with a broad `git add -A`, so they can sweep any inventoried file rather than a listed one, which means a path-listing fix cannot be complete even in principle. Option (a) is 31 edits and a 32nd chance to forget; the derive-the-set answer is the right one and the row stays open for it. (2) THE COMMIT LOOP COSTS TWELVE TIMES ITS PINNED FIGURE: CLAUDE.md §6 pins gate 13 at 39.3 s over 55 tests and the whole loop at ~75 s; measured twice with markers on 2026-08-29 that stage is 501.6 s over 811 tests and the manuscripts suite adds ~430 s. Nothing is broken, both runs were green, and that is exactly why it rots quietly — the only symptom is every session budgeting its turn against a number that has not been true for days. Filed as AUT-PD-172, with the one thing NOT measured said plainly: whether that is suite growth or a per-test regression needs both timed on one machine.
what_it_cost: $0 in this session. CPU only: two artifact regenerations, four scoped pytest runs, one preflight. The dispatched `panels` workflow is GitHub Actions minutes on a public repository — no metered spend.

anti_gaming.invariant: research-loop §6 — a bar may not be changed by the cycle the bar just blocked.
anti_gaming.how_it_was_honoured: The four control tests that pin AUT-PROP-048's narrow finding were again NOT touched, and MEMBERSHIP_SOURCE was NOT moved: this cycle built the read and dispatched the fetch, and left the decision to the cycle that will hold the numbers. AUT-PD-170 now says explicitly that a later cycle MAY move those bars, and that moving them without the measurement is not permitted.
anti_gaming.self_serving_check: Does this change make it easier for me to report success? The honest risk is the opposite one: this cycle wrote the instrument most likely to overturn this repository's own positive result and dispatched it, which is why the row it leaves behind says in its own words that the answer may be that NDRG1 separates in NEITHER series and that the taker must not prefer the read that keeps the finding. The one place a self-serving edit could hide is the background's sampling rule — a filter that quietly enriched the pool would move every null — so `sampling_frame` is recorded in the block and the 'unfiltered' claim is mutation-tested rather than asserted.

⛔ THE WORKFLOW FIX WAS WRONG ON ITS FIRST WRITING AND WAS CAUGHT BEFORE IT SHIPPED. It regenerated the manifest inline before `publish_artifacts.sh`, i.e. over an uncommitted tree, which writes `git_tree_is_clean_apart_from_this_manifest: false` — a provenance failure `--check-archive` refuses. It would have caused the exact red trunk it was written to prevent. Found by reading `publish_artifacts.sh` after the LOCAL archive gate refused the same mistake in my own tree, not by CI. Rewritten as a second publish call after the artifacts are committed; the running preflight was killed rather than protected.

⛔ AND ONE DEFECT OF MINE DID REACH THE TRUNK: 5000f284c published an archive manifest whose `git_revision` named local commit 02235d334, which the rebase-before-push rewrote to 5a744f4ff. Caught one commit later by the guard AUT-PD-141 exists for, fixed by regenerating at a PUSHED commit, and filed as AUT-PD-175. Following AUT-PD-168's ordering rule exactly was not sufficient: 'clean tree' and 'published HEAD' are different properties and only the first was checked.
